brief.meaningEn: Lose the energy, appeal or excitement that once made an activity or subject engaging.
brief.meaningZh: 原本有吸引力的活動或主題逐漸失去活力和趣味。
brief.grammar: Lose + possessive + spark; lose inflects lost/losing. The subject is an activity, project or person’s enthusiasm; spark is figurative, not a real flame.
brief.register: Conversational evaluative English. An exhibition curator may use it when discussing visitor engagement with a colleague.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有昔日吸引力與如今明顯減弱的對照；一名觀眾不喜歡，未必代表整個項目已失去活力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是電器沒有火花，也不表示已無法透過合適改動重拾興趣。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原先吸引之處、興趣下降的證據，以及可能的改進。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 220, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The subject may lose its spark without variety.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: The local-history walk used to draw questions at every stop, but the unchanged script now leaves most visitors silent and early departures have risen. The walk has lost its spark; the guide plans to add short object-handling stops.
listening.zh: 本地歷史導賞以前每站都引來提問，但多年不變的講稿如今令大部分訪客沉默，提早離開的人亦增加。導賞失去原有吸引力，導遊打算加入短暫的實物體驗站。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼顯示導賞吸引力下降？

options.en: Questions have faded and more visitors leave before the end.
options.zh: 提問減少，更多訪客未完便離開。

options.en: The script changes each week and visitors ask more questions.
options.zh: 講稿每週改動，訪客提問增加。

options.en: One visitor chooses a different tour for an unrelated reason.
options.zh: 一名訪客因無關原因選擇另一導賞。

options.en: The guide has already tested the new stops and confirmed their effect.
options.zh: 導遊已測試新站並確認成效。

listening.explanationZh: 過往踴躍與如今沉默、早退形成對照。

reply.promptEn: A club’s weekly science demonstration used to fill the room, but attendance has fallen after the same routine ran for a year. Members say they miss trying things themselves. What happened to the activity?
reply.promptZh: （一個科學社的每週示範原本座無虛席，但同一流程做了一年後，出席人數下降。會員說他們想親手試做。活動出現了甚麼變化？）

options.en: The repeated format has become less engaging.
options.zh: 重複形式變得較不吸引。

options.en: Attendance is lower than before.
options.zh: 出席人數比以前少。

options.en: The demonstration has lost its spark for these members.
options.zh: 對這些會員來說，示範失去原有吸引力。

options.en: Hands-on work may address the stated concern, though it has not been tested yet.
options.zh: 親手操作或可回應他們的意見，但尚未測試。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據前後對照與會員回饋回答。

scene.promptZh: 攝影展去年能引發長時間討論，今年展品與講解全無變動，訪客大多匆匆走過。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The exhibition has lost its spark.
options.zh: 展覽失去原有吸引力。

options.en: Every visitor is still discussing the display for longer than before.
options.zh: 每位訪客仍比以前討論得更久。

options.en: The curator has already proved that a new display will fail.
options.zh: 策展人已證明新展示必定失敗。

scene.explanationZh: 昔日討論熱烈，如今匆匆走過，顯示吸引力下降。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 a project lost its spark？

options.en: Participants still arrive eagerly, ask more questions and stay longer than last year.
options.zh: 參與者仍熱切到場，比去年提更多問題、逗留更久。

options.en: A once-popular workshop now has fewer returning members who call it repetitive.
options.zh: 昔日熱門的工作坊如今回頭會員減少，還被指重複。

options.en: An unchanged tour that once prompted discussion now ends with little engagement.
options.zh: 昔日能引發討論的導賞一直沒改，如今結束時少有人投入。

contrast.explanationZh: 持續且更強的投入，與失去吸引力不符。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The reading club used to spark lively debate, but after months of the same format members barely speak and attendance has slipped. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：讀書會以前討論熱烈，但同一形式做了數月，會員如今幾乎不發言，出席人數也下降。乙：______）

options.en: It seems the club has lost its spark.
options.zh: 讀書會看來失去原有吸引力。

options.en: The decline in discussion is worth asking members about.
options.zh: 討論減少，值得向會員了解原因。

options.en: The old format may no longer engage them.
options.zh: 舊形式可能不再吸引他們。

options.en: A different discussion format could be tried and evaluated.
options.zh: 可試行另一種討論形式並評估成效。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句根據昔日熱烈與如今冷清作出有界判斷。

speaking.en: The youth orchestra lost its spark after rehearsals became a fixed sequence with no chance for players to suggest interpretations; the conductor asked members what they wanted to explore.
speaking.zh: 青年樂團排練變成固定流程，樂手無機會提出演繹建議後，失去原有活力；指揮於是詢問團員想探索甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 指出吸引力下降與具體原因，避免歸咎每名團員。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩個活動昔日吸引人，近來有具體參與下降證據。用英文寫出前後對照及一項待測改進。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不可只憑單一人意見便斷定整體失去活力；改進尚未測試時不可宣稱必成功。

examples.en: The neighbourhood quiz has lost its spark: last year teams argued happily over clues, but now many leave early. The organiser will test shorter rounds next month.
examples.zh: 社區問答遊戲失去原有吸引力：去年隊伍會愉快地爭論線索，如今不少人提早離開。主辦人下月將測試較短回合。

examples.en: The craft club lost its spark when its workshops repeated the same pattern; return visits fell, so members proposed trying a guest-led session and checking attendance.
examples.zh: 手工藝社的工作坊不斷重複同一模式後，失去原有活力；回頭參與人數下降，會員因此建議試行嘉賓主持的一節課，並核對出席情況。

takeaways.en: Lose its spark means become less lively or engaging than before.
takeaways.zh: lose its spark 指比以前少了活力或吸引力。

takeaways.en: Look for a before-and-after change before saying an activity lost its spark.
takeaways.zh: 說活動失去吸引力前，要找出前後變化。

brief.meaningEn: Vary a familiar routine or method to make it more effective, fresh or interesting.
brief.meaningZh: 改變一成不變的流程或方法，令活動更新鮮或更有效。
brief.grammar: Mix things up is a fixed phrasal verb; mix inflects mixed/mixing. Things refers to the routine or approach, not literally stirring objects.
brief.register: Conversational and upbeat. A club organiser may suggest it to colleagues planning a repeated weekly activity.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有原有做法與具體變化；把材料弄亂或毫無目標地改動，不等於有效轉換方式。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把物品攪拌在一起，也不保證任何新方法都比舊方法好。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出原流程、所作變化與待觀察的成效。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 220, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Teachers can mix things up with role-play.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: The weekly reading circle always began with a long lecture, and members rarely spoke. This month the host mixed things up by starting with pairs who compare one paragraph; she will check whether more people contribute.
listening.zh: 每週閱讀小組總以長篇講解開始，會員很少發言。本月主持人轉換做法，先讓兩人一組比較一段文字；她會觀察是否有更多人參與。

options.en: She replaced the lecture-first opening with paired discussion.
options.zh: 她把先聽長篇講解改為兩人討論。

options.en: She kept the opening identical and measured nothing.
options.zh: 她把開場完全維持不變，也沒有觀察。

options.en: She changed the book’s author rather than the session format.
options.zh: 她只改書本作者，沒有改活動形式。

options.en: She has already proved every member prefers the new approach.
options.zh: 她已證明所有會員都較喜歡新方法。

listening.explanationZh: 先講解變成先兩人討論，是具體流程變化。

reply.promptEn: A museum tour has followed the same room order for months. The guide starts one session with a short object comparison and then returns to the usual route, planning to ask visitors what helped. What did the guide do?
reply.promptZh: （博物館導賞數月來一直按同一房間次序進行。導遊有一節先讓訪客短暫比較兩件物品，再走平常路線，並打算詢問甚麼做法有幫助。導遊做了甚麼？）

options.en: The guide introduced a different opening activity.
options.zh: 導遊加入了不同的開場活動。

options.en: The session format changed without abandoning the whole route.
options.zh: 活動形式有變，但沒有捨棄整條路線。

options.en: The guide mixed things up with an object comparison.
options.zh: 導遊用實物比較轉換做法。

options.en: Visitor feedback will help assess whether the change worked.
options.zh: 訪客意見將有助評估改動是否有效。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據小幅但具體的流程變化回答。

scene.promptZh: 書法社每次都只臨摹範本；主持人這週加入兩人互評一筆筆畫，並記錄回饋。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The host mixed things up with peer feedback.
options.zh: 主持人加入同伴回饋，轉換做法。

options.en: The host kept exactly the same activity and sought no feedback.
options.zh: 主持人沿用完全相同活動，也沒有收集回饋。

options.en: The new method is certain to suit every member.
options.zh: 新方法一定適合每名會員。

scene.explanationZh: 原活動加入具體新環節，仍需評估效果。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 organisers mixed things up？

options.en: They repeat the same presentation in the same order without trying any new element.
options.zh: 他們照舊以同一順序重複同一簡報，沒有試新元素。

options.en: They alternate a demonstration with a short hands-on task.
options.zh: 他們在示範與短暫親手操作之間交替。

options.en: They begin one session with questions rather than the usual lecture.
options.zh: 他們有一節先以提問開場，而非如常講解。

contrast.explanationZh: 完全沒有形式或方法上的變化。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The volunteers have practised the same packing drill for weeks. We could try a timed team rotation tomorrow, then compare errors with the old drill. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：義工練習同一包裝流程已有數週。我們明天可試行限時小組輪換，再與舊流程比較錯誤數。乙：______）

options.en: We can mix things up with the rotation and review the results.
options.zh: 我們可以用輪換轉換做法，再檢討結果。

options.en: Comparing errors would tell us more than guessing.
options.zh: 比較錯誤數會比猜測更有根據。

options.en: That would give us a clear change to test.
options.zh: 這是一項可清楚測試的改動。

options.en: The old drill remains a useful comparison point.
options.zh: 舊流程仍可作有用的比較基準。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句包含具體變化及後續評估。

speaking.en: To mix things up at the map workshop, the facilitator let small groups test routes before she explained the official key; she then asked which sequence supported understanding.
speaking.zh: 為讓地圖工作坊有變化，主持人先讓小組測試路線，再解釋官方圖例，並詢問哪個次序更有助理解。
speaking.promptZh: 有明確改動與可評估的教學目的。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩位負責人替重複多次的活動加入不同做法，並準備檢查成效。用英文交代舊做法、新環節與檢查方法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不能只說「做得不同」，須有具體做法，也不能預先聲稱新方法必定成功。

examples.en: The safety briefing used to be a long talk. Mira mixed things up with a short route-finding exercise and will compare the questions people ask afterward.
examples.zh: 安全簡介以前是長篇講解。米拉加入短暫尋路練習，轉換做法，並將比較其後參加者提出的問題。

examples.en: The photography club always judged prints in silence; its chair mixed things up by asking pairs to discuss one lighting choice, then collected anonymous feedback.
examples.zh: 攝影社以往總是默默評選照片；主席請兩人一組討論一項用光選擇，以此轉換做法，其後收集匿名回饋。

takeaways.en: Mix things up means introduce variety into a familiar routine.
takeaways.zh: mix things up 指為熟悉流程加入變化。

takeaways.en: Describe the old routine and the new step when you say someone mixed things up.
takeaways.zh: 說有人轉換做法時，要交代舊流程與新環節。

brief.meaningEn: Make the atmosphere of a gathering feel noticeably warmer, livelier or more positive through one’s presence or enthusiasm.
brief.meaningZh: 透過在場或熱情，使一個聚會的氣氛明顯變得較溫暖、活躍或正面。
brief.grammar: Light up a room; light has past lit. The room is figurative for the people and atmosphere, not electrical illumination.
brief.register: Warm, conversational praise. A colleague may say it about a volunteer who puts nervous guests at ease.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有他人在場時氣氛的可觀察變化；受歡迎不等於此人永遠快樂，亦不代表每人反應完全一樣。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是打開燈，也不能只因外貌亮眼便推斷能帶動氣氛。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描寫此人的具體行動及群體氣氛如何轉變。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 220, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Her enthusiasm can light up a room.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: At the first volunteer meeting, several newcomers sat quietly. Amina welcomed each person by name, asked about their interests and got three groups chatting; her easy warmth lit up a room that had felt tense.
listening.zh: 首次義工會議上，數名新人安靜坐着。阿米娜逐一叫名字歡迎他們，詢問興趣，讓三組人聊起來；她親切的態度令原本緊張的氣氛活躍起來。

options.en: Previously quiet newcomers began talking in small groups.
options.zh: 原本安靜的新人開始分組交談。

options.en: Amina switched on the ceiling lamps.
options.zh: 阿米娜打開天花燈。

options.en: Every attendee became her close friend immediately.
options.zh: 每位參加者立刻成了她的摯友。

options.en: The meeting ended before anyone spoke.
options.zh: 任何人發言前，會議便結束。

listening.explanationZh: 從緊張沉默轉為多人交談，是氣氛轉變的證據。

reply.promptEn: A nervous audience waits for a community storytelling night. The host greets people warmly, invites a light opening story and soon several listeners smile and join in. How did the host affect the gathering?
reply.promptZh: （社區故事夜開始前，觀眾有點緊張。主持人熱情打招呼，邀請一個輕鬆的開場故事，不久已有數名聽眾微笑並參與。主持人如何影響聚會？）

options.en: The host helped the audience relax and take part.
options.zh: 主持人幫助觀眾放鬆並參與。

options.en: The atmosphere became warmer after the welcome.
options.zh: 歡迎過後，氣氛變得較溫暖。

options.en: The host lit up a room through the welcoming opening.
options.zh: 主持人以親切開場令現場氣氛活躍。

options.en: The listeners’ smiles and participation are visible signs of the shift.
options.zh: 聽眾的笑容與參與是轉變的可見跡象。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據開場與觀眾反應回答。

scene.promptZh: 一名團員在緊張的綵排前熱情歡迎新演員，帶大家做簡短破冰，其他人開始互相交談。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Her welcome lit up a room that had felt tense.
options.zh: 她的歡迎令原本緊張的現場氣氛活躍。

options.en: She changed the light bulbs before the rehearsal.
options.zh: 她在綵排前更換燈泡。

options.en: No one responded to her greeting or spoke afterward.
options.zh: 沒有人回應她，也沒有人其後交談。

scene.explanationZh: 熱情行動與人們開始交談，支持比喻用法。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 someone lit up a room？

options.en: A technician turns on brighter lights, while the quiet audience remains tense and silent.
options.zh: 技術員調亮燈光，但安靜的觀眾仍緊張沉默。

options.en: A greeter’s warm questions get several shy guests talking.
options.zh: 接待員親切提問，令數名害羞賓客聊起來。

options.en: A singer’s joyful introduction eases the group and prompts lively responses.
options.zh: 歌手愉快的介紹令大家放鬆，反應熱烈。

contrast.explanationZh: 只有照明變亮，未見群體氣氛因人而轉變。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The workshop began awkwardly, but Sora welcomed the new families, learned their names and soon everyone was sharing ideas. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：工作坊開頭有點尷尬，但索拉歡迎新家庭、記住他們的名字，不久大家都分享想法。乙：______）

options.en: She really lit up a room that had felt awkward.
options.zh: 她確實令原本尷尬的現場氣氛活躍起來。

options.en: Learning names seems to have made the guests more comfortable.
options.zh: 記住名字似乎令賓客更自在。

options.en: Her welcome helped people join the conversation.
options.zh: 她的歡迎有助大家加入討論。

options.en: The group’s shift from silence to sharing is clear.
options.zh: 群體由沉默變成分享，轉變很明顯。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句根據歡迎行動與氣氛轉變作出稱讚。

speaking.en: At the neighbourhood meal, Dev’s stories and attentive questions lit up a room of strangers: tables that had been quiet began exchanging memories.
speaking.zh: 鄰里聚餐時，戴夫的故事與細心提問令滿室陌生人的氣氛活躍起來：原本安靜的各桌開始分享回憶。
speaking.promptZh: 要讓讀者看見人們的反應，而不只下評語。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩人用具體熱情行動令原本冷清或緊張的聚會變得較投入。用英文寫出前後氣氛與他人反應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不可把真的開燈當成比喻，也不要說所有人都必然受感染。

examples.en: Before the science fair opened, visitors waited in silence; Neri’s playful questions lit up a room, and several children began explaining their models to one another.
examples.zh: 科學展開場前，訪客安靜等候；妮莉俏皮的提問令現場氣氛活躍起來，數名孩子開始互相介紹模型。

examples.en: The reunion started stiffly, but Omar’s warm introductions lit up a room: guests from different years soon compared their old photographs.
examples.zh: 重聚會開頭拘謹，但奧馬爾親切介紹令現場氣氛活躍：不同年份的賓客很快便比較舊照片。

takeaways.en: Light up a room means make the social atmosphere warmer and livelier.
takeaways.zh: light up a room 指令社交氣氛更溫暖活躍。

takeaways.en: Show people’s reactions when describing how someone lit up a room.
takeaways.zh: 描述有人帶動氣氛時，要寫出人們的反應。

brief.meaningEn: Resolve a mistaken understanding by explaining the relevant facts or intentions.
brief.meaningZh: 透過解釋相關事實或原意，消除錯誤理解。
brief.grammar: Clear up a misunderstanding / clear up misunderstandings; clear inflects. A specific mistaken belief should be identified before claiming it has been resolved.
brief.register: Neutral everyday English. A coordinator may use it after explaining changed arrangements to attendees.
brief.boundaryZh: 要指出誤會是甚麼，以及有何解釋或核實使之消除；單是重複聲明，不表示對方已明白。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把物品清理乾淨，也不是要求他人停止提問便算釐清。
brief.outcomeZh: 能交代錯誤理解、澄清證據與對方更新後的理解。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 221, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The teacher stayed late to clear up misunderstandings.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: Parents thought the museum workshop had been cancelled because its room changed. The organiser showed the new room notice and confirmed the same start time; their replies showed that this cleared up a misunderstanding.
listening.zh: 家長以為博物館工作坊因轉換房間而取消。主辦人出示新房間通知，並確認開始時間不變；家長回覆顯示這釐清了誤會。

options.en: The workshop was still on, though it had moved rooms.
options.zh: 工作坊仍會舉行，只是改了房間。

options.en: The start time had moved by two hours.
options.zh: 開始時間延遲了兩小時。

options.en: The organiser had cancelled all workshops.
options.zh: 主辦人取消了所有工作坊。

options.en: The parents were asking about ticket prices rather than the room.
options.zh: 家長問的是票價而非房間。

listening.explanationZh: 新房間通知與相同開始時間推翻了取消的誤解。

reply.promptEn: A team reads a short email as a rejection of its proposal. The sender explains that she only asked for one missing cost figure, and the team replies that it understands the proposal remains under review. What happened?
reply.promptZh: （團隊把一封短電郵理解為提案遭否決。寄件人解釋她只是要求補上一項成本數字，團隊回覆說已明白提案仍在審核。發生了甚麼事？）

options.en: The sender corrected the team’s mistaken reading.
options.zh: 寄件人糾正了團隊的錯誤理解。

options.en: The team now knows the proposal has not been rejected.
options.zh: 團隊現在知道提案未遭否決。

options.en: The explanation cleared up a misunderstanding.
options.zh: 解釋釐清了誤會。

options.en: The team’s reply shows its understanding changed.
options.zh: 團隊的回覆顯示理解已改變。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均有原誤解、澄清及更新後的理解。

scene.promptZh: 學生把「星期五前交草稿」理解為星期五早上前；老師說明星期五下午五時才截止，學生回覆確認。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The clarification cleared up the misunderstanding about the deadline.
options.zh: 澄清釐清了截止時間的誤會。

options.en: The teacher merely repeated “Friday” without specifying a time.
options.zh: 老師只重複「星期五」，沒有說明時間。

options.en: The student still believes the deadline is Friday morning.
options.zh: 學生仍以為星期五早上截止。

scene.explanationZh: 具體時間與學生確認顯示理解已更新。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 the misunderstanding was cleared up？

options.en: The organiser repeats the same vague notice, and attendees still believe the event was cancelled.
options.zh: 主辦人重複同一份含糊通知，參加者仍以為活動取消。

options.en: The organiser gives the new room number, and attendees confirm they will go there.
options.zh: 主辦人給出新房號碼，參加者確認會到那裏。

options.en: A teacher states the exact deadline, and pupils restate it correctly.
options.zh: 教師說明確切截止時間，學生正確重述。

contrast.explanationZh: 原誤解仍存在，未有釐清證據。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The note about moving the venue made Hana think the talk was cancelled. I showed her the updated room number, and she said she will attend. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：關於轉換場地的通知令花娜以為講座取消。我向她展示更新房號，她說會出席。乙：______）

options.en: You cleared up the misunderstanding about the talk.
options.zh: 你釐清了她對講座的誤會。

options.en: The room number seems to have corrected her reading.
options.zh: 房號似乎修正了她的理解。

options.en: She now knows the talk is still going ahead.
options.zh: 她現在知道講座仍會舉行。

options.en: Her plan to attend shows she understood the update.
options.zh: 她打算出席，顯示已明白更新安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句以原誤解與更新後的行動為證。

speaking.en: A revised timetable cleared up misunderstandings about the ferry: the last departure was at six, not five, and passengers confirmed the new time before booking.
speaking.zh: 修訂時間表釐清了渡輪安排的誤會：最後一班是六時而非五時，乘客訂票前確認了新時間。
speaking.promptZh: 指出舊理解、正確資訊及確認。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩組人各有一項可指明的錯誤理解，負責人提供證據或具體說明，對方確認已更新理解。用英文寫出三步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不能只靠說話者自稱澄清，須有對方改變理解的跡象。

examples.en: The library notice made visitors think the archive had closed; a staff member showed its new entrance on a map and cleared up the misunderstanding when they confirmed they could still visit.
examples.zh: 圖書館通知令訪客以為檔案館關閉；職員在地圖上指出新入口，訪客確認仍可參觀後，誤會便獲釐清。

examples.en: The trainees thought the safety check was optional. The coordinator demonstrated the required step, cleared up their misunderstanding and heard them repeat it correctly.
examples.zh: 實習生以為安全檢查可自行選擇。協調員示範必做步驟，釐清他們的誤會，並聽到他們正確重述。

takeaways.en: Clear up misunderstandings means resolve mistaken beliefs through explanation.
takeaways.zh: clear up misunderstandings 指透過解釋消除錯誤理解。

takeaways.en: Confirmation from listeners helps show that you cleared up a misunderstanding.
takeaways.zh: 聽者確認，有助顯示誤會已釐清。
